Container.Name: Brave-Origin
Container.Overview: Run Brave Origin in your web browser over HTTPS. Choose Wayland stable (default), Wayland beta, X11 stable, or X11 beta when installing through Apps. Saves bookmarks, settings, and downloads. Includes password protection, copy and paste, audio, and automatic browser updates.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: brave browser wayland x11 selkies kasmvnc remote web ozone

Config.Name: Web HTTPS Port
Config.Description: Single-origin HTTPS web port for remote browser access.

Config.Name: Config & Profile Storage
Config.Description: Persistent directory for browser profile, downloads, and state.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Initial login password. Required when password protection is enabled; use reset-password.sh to change it after setup.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container user ID (Unraid default: 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container group ID (Unraid default: 100).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation permissions mask.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone.

Config.Name: Automatic Display Resize
Config.Description: Resize the desktop to fit your browser window automatically. Disable only to use a fixed width and height.

Config.Name: Keep Browser Maximized
Config.Description: Prevent minimizing, restoring, or dragging a maximized browser window. Disable to restore the previous window controls.

Config.Name: Display Width
Config.Description: Fixed desktop width in pixels; used only when Automatic Display Resize is disabled.

Config.Name: Display Height
Config.Description: Fixed desktop height in pixels; used only when Automatic Display Resize is disabled.

Config.Name: Enable Audio
Config.Description: Enable PulseAudio virtual sink and unified Opus audio streaming.

Config.Name: Automatic Updates
Config.Description: Download browser updates in the background and install them while the browser is stopped.

Config.Name: Hardware Acceleration
Config.Description: Enable hardware acceleration (mount /dev/dri devices).

Config.Name: Require Password
Config.Description: Require a password to open the browser. Set a password below before starting.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Username for the web login.

Config.Name: GPU Device
Config.Description: Render device to use when /dev/dri is passed through.
